notes: SaaS vendor for multi-tenant knowledge-bases. Goal: reduce search latency and unit cost while improving answer relevance via embeddings + rerank. POC is focused on: (1) embedding candidate recall at scale, (2) cross-encoder rerank latency and CPU/GPU tradeoffs, (3) end-to-end p95 query latency and cost. Current infra: customer runs nightly ingestion pipeline, ~12M passages indexed for production (text chunks ~150-300 tokens), POC subset = 3M passages. Peak QPS target 300-500 (burst to 750), operational SLO p95 <= 250ms for query+rerank. Cost target: < $0.02 / query (including embedding lookup + rerank). Preference for open models (smaller embed dims to reduce vector db cost) but open to Redwood-verified embeddings if unit economics match. Wants hosted API for fast time-to-value; will consider Dedicated if per-token/emb cost with hosted API can't meet budget. Security: must support SAML SSO, audit logs, and EU data residency for EU customers. Legal expects a data handling appendix. AE note: "VP Eng said: 'If you can hit 200-250ms p95 at 500 QPS with cost under $0.02, we'll go long-term'".
